definitions.full: H3890. levath לְוָת preposition to, at, beside (derivation uncertain; see K 128n .; perhaps akin to לְוִי לָוָה, , join ; לְוָת ᵑ7 , Syriac to ), with מִן , Ezra 4:12 the Jews which came up מִןלְֿוָתָח from thee ( de chez toi ; compare , מִלְּוַת , e.g. Exod 8:8 ; 9:33 ᵑ7 ᵑ6 = Hebrew מֵעִם ).
